name: Horizon Principled BRDF
definition: A Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF) used in the Horizon rendering engine, composed of a diffuse component ($f_d$) and a specular component ($f_s$), designed to be compatible with Disney's principled shading approach.
summary: The Horizon Principled BRDF is a physically plausible shading model that sets itself apart by fixing specific microfacet parameters and implementing a diffuse Fresnel variation to correct edge darkening.
